title: Overview
content:
# YiVad

Vue 3.5 admin dashboard for the Yi family.

- **Stack**: Vue 3.5 + TypeScript, Rsbuild 1, Pinia 4, Element Plus 2.14, ECharts 6
- **Axis**: componentization
- **Table pattern**: ProTable (no raw `el-table`)
- **Permissions**: `v-auth` directive, never inline `v-if`

title: Architecture
content:
# Architecture

Single SPA with dynamic routing from the backend menu API.

- `src/views/` — pages by feature domain
- `src/components/` — ProTable, ECharts, Upload, WangEditor
- `src/stores/` — Pinia setup-function stores
- `src/api/modules/` — domain services

All cross-project calls use the RPC envelope over `POST /`.

title: Overview
content:
# YiAi

FastAPI backend — single source of truth for all data.

- **Runtime**: uvicorn (ASGI) on port 10086
- **DB**: MongoDB via Motor (async)
- **Axis**: modularization
- **LLM**: Ollama (self-hosted)

title: API Reference
content:
# RPC Envelope

```
POST /  body: { module_name, method_name, parameters }
response: { code, message, data }
```

Key contracts:

- `data_service.query_documents` uses `filter`, never `query`
- `/read-file` and `/write-file` use `target_file`, never `path`
- collection parameter is `cname` / `collection_name`

title: Overview
content:
# YiPet

Chrome MV3 extension — interactive pet companion.

- **Stack**: React 18 + Ant Design 5
- **Axis**: componentization + API layering
- **API**: 4-tier (client → endpoints → types → services)
- **Boundary**: ISOLATED + MAIN worlds

title: Overview
content:
# YiKnowledge

Markdown knowledge base — 7 role directories, 4 pipeline stages.

Serves both humans (documentation) and AI (RAG data source).

- kebab-case filenames only
- frontmatter required: `title`, `tags`, `category`, `created`, `updated`, `source`, `type`, `status`
